text:
maria: Quick heads-up — customer onboarding (FinAP) just asked for an "eval-triggered alerts" workflow + a per-model quantization recommendation API. Can we sketch a playbook and minimal launch gates this week?
raj: Do we mean alerts that fire when eval metrics drift vs baseline, or more ad-hoc guardrails from customer tests?
maria: Both. Primary is eval-driven drift (concordance/drop in top-k), secondary is manual test failures flagged by CS. Want a predictable response path for pilots.
olivia: Infra questions: how noisy will alerts be? we need rate limits and dedupe rules so SRE/Ops don't drown.
tim: Proposal for acceptance: 1) alert FPR < 10% on pilot data, 2) median time-to-investigation < 4h, 3) auto-rollback path to compatible quantized fallback model.
alex: For quant recs API — return a ranked list: [quant_profile, est_cost_delta, est_quality_delta, confidence]. Keep denom small so customers can programmatically pick.
maria: Love that. For pilot gate: require at least one customer to opt in (beta) + playbook steps documented + `rollback` flag available in Console.
deploy-bot: feature-flag change: optimize.eval_alerts beta toggled ON for team:product at 2025-10-12T15:02:05Z
raj: API surface thought: POST /v1/optimize/recommendations {model, workload_meta, eval_set} -> returns profiles. Keep response streaming-friendly for large evals.
olivia: Observability: need per-alert provenance (which eval, which prompt-set), and a sampling hook so we can attach model outputs for offline triage.
tim: Ops runbook draft: 1) Triage -> 2) Run quick eval slice -> 3) If regression confirmed, execute auto-fallback -> 4) Notify CS + customer. Add SLA commitments for pilot.
maria: Next steps: raj & alex to draft API proto + minimal payload, olivia to propose rate/dedupe rules, tim to author runbook checklist. Sync Thu 10:30. @here please flag any customer constraints. :eyes:
raj: Will start API proto, will include small JSON example & pagination for streaming.
alex: I'll mock quant scoring heuristic (simple: quality_loss_per_token + cost_delta) and a test harness.
olivia: I'll sketch dedupe rules (min 30m window per model+customer+alert-type) and retention for sampled outputs (30 days max).
tim: I'll put runbook in Confluence and add a trivial incident playbook for pilots.
maria: Thanks — aiming for beta-ready in 3 sprints (with one integration pilot). If blockers surface, raise here. :rocket:
